Initial cleaning, modified from Iris' code

```{r}
library(dplyr)
getwd()

data_originalFU2 = read.csv("C:/r_projects/Autism and Schizotypy/asdsz/Schizotypy and Autism_FU2.csv")
```

Create a data frame with all of the questions
```{r}
content_FU2 = data_originalFU2 %>% dplyr::select(MSS._1:Q58)
questions_FU2 <- sapply(content_FU2[1, ], function(x) sub("^.*?- ", "", as.character(x)))

df_FU2=as.data.frame(questions_FU2)

write.csv(df_FU2, "all questions_FU2.csv")

```

Filter out folks without IDs, who did not consent, and who have been living in the US less than 2 years. 

```{r}

data_FU2 <- data_originalFU2 %>% dplyr::filter(ID != "", consent1 != "", US >= 2)

##remove unnecessary rows (first row)
data_FU2 = data_FU2[-1,]

##and unnecessary columns so that only ID and survey questions remain ##need to add demos to a separate df
data_FU2 = data_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(-(StartDate:parent_edu), -PROLIFIC_PID)
```

Attention Check Items. Only retain participants who passed 5 attention check items and then remove the attention check columns so they are not counted in the data analysis.

```{r}
question_FU2 = data_FU2[1,] %>% as.vector() %>% unlist() %>% unname()
name_FU2 = colnames(data_FU2)
quest_df_FU2 = data.frame(question_FU2, name_FU2)

##only retain participants who passed 5 attention check items and then remove the attention check columns so they are not counted in the data analysis
data_attention_checked_FU2 = data_FU2 %>% filter(AQ._24 == "Agree") %>%
  filter(SeSS_14 == "Prefer Not to Answer") %>%
  filter(WSS_32 == "TRUE") %>% 
  filter(SPQ_6 == "Strongly Agree") %>% 
  filter(REI._5 == "somewhat false") %>%
  dplyr::select(-AQ._24,-SeSS_14, -WSS_32, -SPQ_6, -REI._5)

##mark all missing and "Prefer Not to Answer" responses as NA
data_attention_checked_FU2[data_attention_checked_FU2 == "" | data_attention_checked_FU2 == "Prefer Not to Answer" | data_attention_checked_FU2 == "Prefer not to Answer"] = NA

```

```{r}
##drop participants who answered less than 90% of questions by 
data_content_FU2 = data_attention_checked_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(MSS._1:Q58) 
check_empty_prop_FU2 = function(x){sum(is.na(x)) /ncol(data_content_FU2)}
data_attention_checked_FU2$empty_prop_FU2 =apply(data_content_FU2, 1, check_empty_prop_FU2)

data_attention_checked_FU2 = data_attention_checked_FU2 %>% filter(empty_prop_FU2 < 0.1)

##remove the empty_prop_FU2 column as it is no longer needed
data_attention_checked_FU2 = data_attention_checked_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(-empty_prop_FU2)

```

##Makes t/f logical and all numbers integers

df_numeric_FU2 = data_attention_checked_FU2 %>% dplyr::select(contains(c("SeSS", "SPQ", "AQ", "Q", "REI"))) %>% dplyr::mutate_all(as.integer)

df_content_FU2 = cbind(ID = data_attention_checked_FU2$ID, df_boolean_FU2, df_numeric_FU2)
